course_name: Applied Machine Learning and Data Mining

learning_outcomes.description: Preprocess raw feature matrices, handle class imbalance, and design cross-validation protocols.
Train and fine-tune classical supervised and unsupervised ML algorithms using Scikit-Learn.
Evaluate models using ROC-AUC, precision-recall curves, and feature importance interpretations (SHAP).

weeks.topic: Machine Learning Foundations, Data Preprocessing, and Train/Val/Test Splits.
Linear Regression, Cost Functions, Gradient Descent, and Regularization (L1/L2).
Logistic Regression, Binary/Multiclass Classification, and Metric Selection.
Support Vector Machines (SVM) and Kernel Methods.
Decision Trees, Bagging, and Random Forest Ensembles.
Midterm Benchmark Evaluation and Model Checkpoint.
Gradient Boosting Machines (XGBoost, LightGBM) and Hyperparameter Tuning.
Unsupervised Learning: K-Means Clustering, PCA, and Dimensionality Reduction.
Recommender Systems and Matrix Factorization Techniques.
Final Model Deployment, Serving, and Production Monitoring.
